name: Vendor Risk Assessment Required
description: A third-party vendor requires a current risk assessment, an acceptable or waived risk rating, and appropriate contractual data-protection terms.

conditions.statement: The vendor has a risk assessment on record, completed within the declared validity period.

requiredEvidence.title: Vendor Risk Assessment — Assessment Date
requiredEvidence.description: The vendor has a risk assessment on record, completed within the declared validity period.

conditions.statement: The assessed risk rating is below the declared acceptance threshold, or has been explicitly waived by an Authority holder.

requiredEvidence.title: Vendor Risk Assessment — Risk Rating
requiredEvidence.description: The assessed risk rating is below the declared acceptance threshold, or has been explicitly waived by an Authority holder.

conditions.statement: Where the vendor processes sensitive data, the contract includes a data-protection clause.

requiredEvidence.title: Vendor Contract — Data Protection Clause
requiredEvidence.description: Where the vendor processes sensitive data, the contract includes a data-protection clause.
